The '''Apgar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==History==
It was the home to Imperial [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]] [[Soron Hegerty]], whose father ruled the system with the start of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EJ" />
